official_reading.level: full fixed SQL and labevents definitions read, not search abstract

policy.specimen_audit: metadata and type-row completeness over selected three lab-item sources, no unallowed clinical-value fetch
policy.chart_window_interpretation: fixed official comparison, not physiological validity
policy.pairs: all physical ties and same-specimen crossproducts; never choose MAX or collapse duplicate events
policy.available_at: unknown for any required storetime missing/invalid/before chart; original event and retrospective ratio retained
policy.numeric_bounds: reuse existing dictionary, not exact official bg.sql cutoff replication
policy.scaling: indexed specimen groups, sorted per-stay chart arrays and binary search; output preserves genuine Cartesian products

preserved_history: No edits to source_events.py, old six-channel candidate, failed a, v1/v2 receipts, concept dictionary or sealed outputs; previous interrupted broad tests not replaced by this finite suite.
